turns.ask: What is louis-agent, in one minute?
criteria: Says it is an AI agent framework in C#
Names the doc it read
Ends with one small nudge: a page, a question or the chat

turns.ask: Why is everything in C# and not Python?
criteria: Gives the reason the docs give
Gives no number or fact the docs don't state

turns.ask: Where can I see what it costs?
criteria: Opens a page that exists on the site
Says in one line what to look at there

turns.ask: Can your agent match my supplier invoices to my bank statement every month?
criteria: Calls it a custom agent Louis can build
Outlines in the visitor's words what it would do
Offers to tell Louis
Never answers "I can't do that"

turns.ask: We're a bank. Our data can't go to a public AI cloud.
criteria: Says it can run in a closed container in their own environment
Mentions Azure's South African region
Says the model is theirs to pick

turns.ask: How many paying customers do you have?
criteria: Says the docs don't say, or that it is a one-person startup
Gives no number the docs don't state
Offers a walkthrough, or to explain one section
Starts with the page's first area
Explains it in two or three sentences
Moves to the next area in the page's order
Lights the area it talks about
